high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from TechCrunch.com, dated 5:09 AM, as indicated by the status bar at the top of the screen. The website's logo, "TC," is prominently displayed on the left side of the header, with a search icon and a menu icon on the right. The article discusses Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg's hiring spree to staff up Meta’s new superintelligence team. It mentions that Meta has reportedly offered employees from OpenAI and Google DeepMind compensation packages worth upwards of $100 million. The article cites a report from Kevin Dietsch / Getty Images for the image
